tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from four different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
OpenAI is bringing its frontier models to Google Cloud. Reported by Axios: the company is expanding where developers can access its latest technology.
Washington's DeepSeek ban may deter US firms from adopting Chinese artificial intelligence models, according to experts. Reported by South China Morning Post: the policy could shape how American companies choose their tools.
Artificial intelligence guardrails aren't stopping criminal hackers from exploiting vulnerabilities. Reported by Wired: security safeguards face real-world challenges from determined threat actors.
Epic is launching an app connector designed for artificial intelligence agents to integrate with its platform. Reported by Modern Healthcare: the move expands how these agents can access healthcare systems.
Free every hour.
